PowerShell is a Windows shell and scripting language. Adversaries abuse
powershell to run commands, download payloads, and load modules in memory.

## Detection

Module logging plus command-line telemetry: `-EncodedCommand`, `-w hidden`,
`-nop`, and `DownloadString` are the high-signal tokens. Ask where the encoded
blob comes from and whether the host is a lab fixture.
